canonicalization.note: complete canonical preimages; version is a hash input, so a version change changes every key

independence_attestation.authored: before and apart from the A04 binder

fields_per_expected_record.rule: only RUNNABLE records may appear in the constructed-job set J; HELD/DENIED/NA must remain visible and must never be runnable

a04_acceptance_contract.note: schema-compatible acceptance contract for A04's binder; supplied WITHOUT inspecting or depending on A04's implementation
requirements: every constructed job carries an exact expected_work_key computed from the five identity kinds above
expected_work_key must be reproducible from a complete canonical preimage and must include an explicit version
the expected set must be reconcilable by OUTER join so that absent mappings remain visible
documentary item key, operation key, expected-work key, execution-attempt key and output identity must not be conflated
jobs must carry multiplicity; one expected operation = one job unless multiplicity is explicitly justified
required consumers must be declared per expected operation, not per product
held/denied/source-nonapplicable obligations must be exported in a separate visible set and must never appear in the job set
threshold or truncation must not be applied before the reconciliation
